title: Fugu Cobblemon
description: A Custom Cobblemon Modpack for Fabric 1.21.1!
body:
A Cobblemon modpack with plenty of extra things to round out the experience! All credit goes to original mod developers and the developers of the Official Cobblemon Modpack!

## Features
- Cobblemon and several Cobblemon Addons!
- Oritech technology!
- Plenty of building options! Furniture, Block variants, and more!
- Armourer's Workshop for all the customizing!
- Better Visuals! (Distant Horizons, Shaders, Etc.)
- Several Quality of Life improvements!
- Reimagined transportation! Sporkcart, Immersive Aircraft, Small Ships, etc!
- And so much more!

## Disclaimer
This pack was made with the sole purpose of being used on the private Fugu Cobblemon SMP server. As such, it may be poorly optimized, and at times confusing to play with, but it can still be enjoyable!
